findings.text: follow-on: the availability competence-refusal (_model_availability_refusal, exit 5) is emitted on the dry-run path before override_resolution is computed, so it is a dry-run refusal document that carries no overrides echo - inconsistent with the claim that every dry-run refusal carries it, and a caller cannot tell a resolved override from one that never applied on that refusal.

follow-on: the --local select_local_backend failure emits {"ok": false, "error": "request-error"} with neither dry_run true nor the overrides echo, so its shape differs from the request-error documents _emit_dry_run_request_error unifies at reckon/cli.py:922.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; b18f8a841 routes a schema-refused --set key to _emit_dry_run_request_error and wraps the pre-check, 95b5bb7dc adds _require_configured_override_paths and applies it before _dispatch_resolved_flight on both paths, fc52b0e63 threads override_resolution through every dry-run refusal via _with_resolved_overrides, dbaa5baee records the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the source node's done-when names tests/test_dry_run_shows_each_set_override.py; the manifest records its 8 cases passing, which I re-ran independently at head dbaa5bae with RECKON_FOLLOWER_OWNER unset, 8 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the gained commits repair three follow-ons the earlier review raised on the dispatch dry run in reckon/cli.py - the launch now refuses an undeclared keyed-map name as the preview does (95b5bb7dc), every dry-run refusal document carries the override echo (fc52b0e63), and a schema-refused --set key answers on the dry-run JSON channel (b18f8a841) - all read in the diff baf499dfd..dbaa5bae.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the repair round, the focused run (8 passed), suite arms base a326205d5 521 passed/1 skipped vs head fc52b0e63 529 passed/1 skipped both EXIT=0, and the stale RECKON_FOLLOWER_OWNER caveat that removes eight follower-admission failures from the measurement.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/cli.py, tests/test_dry_run_shows_each_set_override.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-dry-run-must-resolve-what-the-real-call-resolves/dry-run-shows-each-set-override.html; git diff --name-only baf499dfd..dbaa5bae lists exactly those three.

justifications.durability: each repair has a red control - reverting the echo reddens 2 cases, the launch refusal 1, the request-error channel 3, every log EXIT=1 - and the launch-parity case at tests/test_dry_run_shows_each_set_override.py:214 monkeypatches reckon.crew.dispatch to raise, so a launch that reached dispatch would fail its own assertion.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's own baseline_suite (logs/gate-base-a326205d5-owner-unset.log, 521 passed) and after_suite (logs/gate-head-repair-owner-unset.log, 529 passed) both end EXIT=0, and I re-derived added_failure_count 0 with a positive control that finds the FAILED id in logs/negative-control-base-arm.log.
justifications.fit: the new helpers are named by mechanism at reckon/cli.py:922, 999, 1021 and 1031 (_emit_dry_run_request_error, _with_resolved_overrides, _layer_flight_config, _require_configured_override_paths), each with a docstring stating why it exists; no plan, version or ticket identifier appears.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/cli.py:1649-1662 runs _layer_flight_config then _require_configured_override_paths before dispatch, so a name no layer defines is refused on both the preview and the launch, closing the dry-run versus real divergence the earlier review named.
justifications.scope_discipline: reckon/cli.py and the two other paths in the diff are exactly the manifest's declared write paths; no plan, index or sprint state is mutated.
